summary.intent: Work through two todos: (1) wire CTR encryption for media uploads through the SDK uploadFile path, and (2) debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging.
summary.outcome: Both PRs (#399, #400) were merged to main. SDK now correctly selects CTR encryption for large media files. BYO mode can now be toggled via a new PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint, and the load test workload was fixed to properly enable BYO and send valid IPNS records.

repo: selectEncryptionMode() existed only in apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts and was never called for new SDK uploads — only for the duplicate-file re-encrypt path. CTR mode was dead code for new uploads.

setByoStatus() in the vault service was a dead method with no controller endpoint — BYO mode could never be toggled via API. This was why register-cid always returned 403, not 400 as the todo described.
The load test byo-file-workload.ts was sending { ipnsName, cid } to ipns-publish but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires { ipnsName, record, metadataCid } — a completely wrong payload shape.

The api:generate script (pnpm api:generate) runs ESLint on the entire repo including Rust target/ build artifacts, causing 261 spurious lint errors. Fixed by adding target/** to eslint.config.js ignores.
NestJS/Swagger does not generate securitySchemes in openapi.json by default — this is expected behavior, not a spec defect.

All API test files used jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern where mock objects lose their mock methods after module.get() — a systemic issue across 9+ spec files requiring a switch to importOriginal + spread pattern.

The release gate workflow breaks immediately on the first failed run in the SHA range without checking if desktop E2E tests actually executed in that run — a skipped test job on a failed run caused valid passing E2E runs to be ignored.
FLAC files (audio/flac) were missing from STREAMING_MIME_TYPES in both packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts.
The .husky/commit-msg file is overwritten locally by the Entire CLI tool — should be added to .git/info/exclude rather than committed, to avoid polluting git diffs.

code.finding: uploadFile() hardcoded encryptAesGcm and encryptionMode: 'GCM' — added optional encryptionMode param, uses encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv when 'CTR'
uploadFile() caller determines mode — added selectEncryptionMode() call before sdkCore.uploadFile(), using MIME type + size threshold identical to the web service
New centralized module: selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) and normalizeEncryptionMode(mode) — single source of truth for CTR/GCM selection logic, imported by both SDK client and web app
createByoClientPool() never enabled BYO mode on test accounts — added PATCH /vault/byo-status call after account creation, filters out failed enables, throws if zero succeed
ipns-publish step sent wrong fields; replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord() from sdk-core which creates a valid signed IPNS record. Also hoisted createSdkContext() outside the per-iteration loop.
Added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint wiring setByoStatus() service method that previously had no controller
Release gate broke on first failed run in SHA range without checking if desktop E2E tests ran — fixed to check whether desktop jobs actually executed before treating a failed run as definitive
Added target/** to ignores — Rust build artifacts were being linted, causing 261 spurious errors on every api:generate run

workflow: When SDK test files mock @cipherbox/sdk-core with a bare factory function, any new export added to sdk-core will cause those tests to fail — use importOriginal + spread to future-proof mocks.

After adding a new API endpoint, orval regeneration creates new model files that must all be staged — using git add packages/api-client/src/ rather than specific files avoids missing generated models.
pnpm api:generate requires the API to be running locally to generate the OpenAPI spec; manually running ts-node generate-openapi.ts writes to cwd if the script is invoked from the wrong directory.
E2E tests against local dev require rebuilding all workspace packages first (sdk-core, sdk) before running Playwright — Vite HMR picks up rebuilt output.
CodeRabbit review threads can be resolved via GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation; REST is needed for replies (with integer in_reply_to field, not string).

friction: GraphQL API for GitHub review threads timed out multiple times, requiring fallback to REST for fetching comments.

Pre-existing TypeScript errors in 9 API test files had to be fixed as a prerequisite — the systemic jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern was broken across republish, shares, tee, vault, and migration specs.
Manual OpenAPI generation wrote to apps/api/openapi.json (cwd) instead of packages/api-client/openapi.json — accidentally committed 3889 spurious lines that had to be immediately reverted.
sdk-core build output was stale during typecheck — required building sdk-core before typechecking the sdk package.
The merge from fix/e2e-test-failures-v2 introduced both a pending/ and done/ copy of the SDK todo, requiring manual cleanup.
api:generate lint step linted Rust target/ directory, producing 261 errors on every run and masking the 1 real warning.
Push commands occasionally appeared to hang — multiple retries and status checks needed to confirm completion.
.husky/commit-msg Entire CLI modifications kept appearing in git diffs, requiring .git/info/exclude configuration.
open_items: Remaining 1 ESLint warning: @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any in apps/api/src/ipns/delegated-routing.client.spec.ts:60 (delegated routing SpyInstance cast)
integration.test.ts in packages/sdk fails with live API errors — pre-existing, not caused by this session's changes
MigrationStatusDto.completedAt typed as object rather than Date — pre-existing Phase 35 DTO issue, Copilot flagged it but was marked not applicable
openapi.json missing securitySchemes — pre-existing NestJS/Swagger behavior, Copilot flagged it but marked not applicable

Pending todos remaining: Offload large file encryption to Web Worker (ui), Add ERC-1271 contract wallet authentication (auth), Research CRDT-based IPNS inbox (architecture), Make search index build async/incremental (ui), Add alternative MFA factor types (auth), Investigate removal of mock-ipns-routing layer (api)
Exclude Rust target/ from ESLint todo was created then immediately resolved inline — todo file in done/ is accurate but the creation/resolution was same-session
